intent: A light country wedding gown in wheat gold and cream linen, with a full linen apron carrying a green heraldic stripe, a fitted dark walnut bodice, pale sleeves flaring only at the forearm and a fanned wheat crown; from the high camera it reads as a warm gold bell under a pale apron with a dark fitted top.
requests: A tapered or wedge skirt panel that widens toward the hem, so the bell grows smoothly in depth as well as width; boxes on two rigid leg panels only step outward.
A gold cloth colour for large surfaces that stays warm under the blue night fill; the hand-mixed wheat gold can drift khaki under the mood preset.
